prompts.title: Low-Angle Cinematic Suit Portrait AI Prompt
prompts.prompt: High-quality semi-realistic digital portrait of a uploaded man, preserving the exact facial structure and age from the reference image. Calm, confident expression with natural masculinity. Wearing round, dark-tinted sunglasses with subtle reflections, a tailored black suit, a crisp white shirt, and a black tie. One hand in his pocket, the other adjusting his sunglasses. Ultra low-angle cinematic shot (35mm), dramatic high-contrast rim lighting, noir mood, clean minimal dark black background. Sleek movie-poster aesthetic, ultra-sharp detail, professional color grading, premium finish. Aspect ratio 4:5. Negative: cartoon, anime, flat style, blur, soft lighting, plastic skin, over-smoothing. Replicate the face exactly, pixel-perfect 1:1.

prompts.title: Monochrome Yellow Studio Fashion Portrait
prompts.prompt:
Ultra-realistic, premium fashion portrait of the uploaded male subject — preserve his natural facial identity, hairstyle, and features with high accuracy.

SETTING: Seamless studio background in bright golden-yellow, with a subtle glow directly behind the subject and a slightly deeper amber tone confined only to the upper corners. Background and floor stay vivid golden yellow — never orange, beige, ochre, brown, or muted mustard.

WARDROBE (keep each layer visually distinct — colors must not merge into one flat brown):
- Golden-mustard hoodie with visible drawstrings (brightest layer)
- Deep caramel-brown teddy fleece jacket worn open over the hoodie so the hoodie stays visible, with clearly defined curly fleece texture
- Warm-brown jogger pants, loose and slightly baggy — extra room through thighs and knees, softly tapered toward the ankle, elastic cuffs, clearly not slim-fit
- Dark caramel-brown suede sneakers with chunky, rugged soles
- Reflective silver aviator sunglasses
- Silver metal wristwatch

POSE & EXPRESSION: Seated confidently on the floor, high-fashion editorial energy. One leg crossed, the other extended toward camera with the shoe as a strong foreground element. Natural, believable hand placement. Expression calm, confident, slightly serious.

CAMERA & FRAMING: Extreme ground-level, low-angle shot positioned close to the extended shoe, tilted upward toward the subject. 24–28mm wide-angle lens for strong forced-perspective — outsole reads much larger than the face. Face sits in the upper-middle third of frame with generous golden background above the head. Full seated pose and both shoes visible, no awkward cropping.

LIGHTING: Strong, clean studio lighting from the upper front-left — brilliant golden highlights, crisp facial definition, realistic metallic reflections, visible fleece fibers, natural fabric folds, detailed suede grain, strong directional shadows beneath body and shoes. Bright exposure, rich saturated color, punchy contrast, shadows deep but detailed.

STYLE: Premium streetwear campaign photography, vibrant commercial color grading, bold wide-angle drama, photorealistic skin texture, anatomically accurate hands and limbs, sharp facial focus, high dynamic range, polished editorial finish, high resolution.

AVOID: faded colors, dusty-orange or beige/sepia cast, matte film look, low saturation, flat lighting, clothing colors blending into one shade, upright/formal posture, small or distant foreground shoe, distorted or extra fingers/hands, distorted or extra legs, eye-level camera angle.

ASPECT RATIO: 4:5 (use 3:4 only if the platform doesn't support 4:5).
